Dear Laura,

Thank you for reaching out and for your kind words about Flowmingo.

The AI interview on Flowmingo is completely free to complete. Optional paid features such as a detailed assessment report or a practice interview are available but are not required as part of the application process. You can apply and complete the AI interview at no cost at https://flowmingo.ai/careers

Let us know if you have any questions,

Best regards,

--
Jessica from Flowmingo Customer Support Team
